unresolved.why: Second stats.bar finding (fixed 72pt category-label frame) not addressed — line 63 still `Text(category.rawValue).font(.caption).frame(width: 72, alignment: .leading)`. Truncates/clips at accessibility text sizes. Fixer correctly declared this skipped (mechanical: false), so it is an honest gap, not a false claim — but the defect stands in code.
unresolved.fix: Use `@ScaledMetric private var labelWidth: CGFloat = 72` and `.frame(minWidth: labelWidth, alignment: .leading)`, or switch the row to a layout that lets the label wrap at AX sizes.

unresolved.why: Label/value split is present (lines 75-76) but `.accessibilityIdentifier("stats.bar")` sits at line 73, BEFORE `.accessibilityElement(children: .combine)` at line 74. Same ordering that produced the pre-repair tree, where the combined row element carried identifier 'stats.chart' (inherited from the ancestor VStack at line 79) and 'stats.bar' landed on the now-merged leaf StaticTexts. After combine those leaves are no longer separate elements, so the anchor 'stats.bar' has no element to attach to and the fixed row is addressable only as 'stats.chart'. The fixer got this ordering right for stats.largest.row (identifier last, line 40) but not here.
unresolved.fix: Move `.accessibilityIdentifier("stats.bar")` to after `.accessibilityValue(...)`, so the order is `.accessibilityElement(children: .combine).accessibilityLabel(...).accessibilityValue(...).accessibilityIdentifier("stats.bar")` — matching the largest-row pattern.
